notes.title: "Trapped In The Omniverse" coming in 2026. Thanks for wishlisting!
notes.content: [h3][b]Hello everyone![/b] [/h3][p]We want to sincerely thank those who have already added "Trapped In The Omniverse" to their wishlist. The game is coming in April 2026 and we are working hard to make it an unforgettable experience. If you haven’t yet, we invite you to join the wishlist and share it with your friends. Your support means everything to us! We will share more news and details soon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293150/8a688c4bdb6e24caa54b3476d4f0328f700982aa.jpg"][/img][/p][previewyoutube="sFDgGI8QLco;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Explore Infinity: Ask me about Trapped In The Omniverse
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="sFDgGI8QLco;full"][/previewyoutube][h2][b]Descend into the Depths of the Omniverse[/b][/h2][p]In [i]Trapped In The Omniverse[/i], every step you take is an invitation to mystery and peril. Creatures lurking in the shadows, ruins shrouded in the mist of time, and secrets as old as infinity itself await those bold enough to explore. Will you dare to face the Ensolve—mutants hiding within endless swamps—or uncover the remnants of a lost civilization and its forbidden weapons?[/p][p]You won’t be entirely alone: unexpected allies stand ready to join your cause, turning the tide in brutal battles and missions that test both your wit and your survival instincts. From decaying high-tech laboratories to uncharted jungles, this journey thrusts you into an Omniverse where triumph and disaster intertwine with every choice you make.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293150/a8ae407269f2927fe4ee1b3ade056da515f0b843.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every mission is more than a challenge—it’s a fragment of a larger riddle, slowly revealing the truth behind the Omniverse and its impossible inhabitants.[/p][h2]Now, the question is yours: [b]what do you want to know?[/b][/h2][p] Ask me anything—about enemies, legendary weapons, hidden abilities, treacherous maps, or invaluable allies. Every answer might grant you the edge to survive… or the key to mastering the Omniverse.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293150/5b454475ad909aa3f5269df5750f5fd1f87281b4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293150/027e18dc13b35e725b8508d128fde2e40c0ffda1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293150/30de9db2ce0ce26d4906afba546b5e94064d258e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Explore the Infinite: Ask Me About Trapped In The Omniverse
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6ss0g7Wleyw;full][/previewyoutube]

Dive into the Depths of the Omniverse in Trapped In The Omniverse

Step into this immersive experience where every corner of the Omniverse holds dark mysteries, insatiable creatures, and secrets lost in the fog of time. Will you dare to face the Ensolves, mutants lurking in shadowy swamps, or uncover the ruins of a lost civilization in search of ancient artifacts and deadly weapons? Not all you meet will be foes; invaluable allies await, ready to aid you in challenging battles and missions.

From high-tech labs to the most impenetrable jungles, Trapped In The Omniverse invites you to explore a universe where danger and reward intertwine at every step. Through missions that test your strategy and skills, you can forge your own legend in this relentless world. Every mission unveils fragments of forgotten stories and brings you closer to understanding the truth behind the Omniverse and its strange inhabitants.

Ask me anything: about the enemies, the legendary weapons and skills you can acquire, the allies by your side, or the maps you need to explore. Each question can spark a revelation that gives you the edge in this odyssey. What will you discover to survive and dominate the Omniverse?
